behavior: Virtual composition retains physical media declarations and creates no synthetic media SHA.
Exact common rational quantum; derived offsets and occurrence identities; registry ordering is irrelevant, sequence ordering is material.
Native support is clipped to each selected occurrence; inverse splits at boundaries, preserves repetitions and refuses nonintegral native coordinates.
Intervals remain unions, gaps remain gaps, points contribute zero duration.
Sherlock uses full declared media durations and primary playback axes, not notebook offsets or the last annotation endpoint.
Rows and scenes retain actual native/composed anchors; selection unions do not double count.
Saved readouts rederive from actual source and query; export grants checked before CLI bin or result reads.
